name: Sprite
explanation: A sprite is a character or object in your project. Each sprite has its own scripts, costumes and sounds.

name: Stage
explanation: The stage is the area where sprites move. It has backdrops and can have scripts of its own. Its centre is x 0, y 0.

name: Script
explanation: A script is a stack of blocks that run from top to bottom, usually starting with an event block.

name: Block
explanation: A block is one instruction or value. Blocks join together to make scripts. Some hold other blocks inside them.

name: Event
explanation: An event is something that happens, such as running the project or pressing a key. An event block starts the script under it when that happens.

name: Sequence
explanation: A sequence is doing steps one after another, in order. Changing the order can change what happens.

name: Loop
explanation: A loop repeats the blocks inside it: a set number of times, forever, or until something becomes true.

name: Condition
explanation: A condition is a question that is true or false, such as whether a key is pressed. An if block runs its inside only when the condition is true.

name: Variable
explanation: A variable is a named place that stores one value, such as a score. You can set it, change it and use it in other blocks.

name: List
explanation: A list is a named, numbered collection of values. You can add items, remove them and read the item at a position. Positions start at 1.

name: Message
explanation: A broadcast message is a signal that one script sends and other scripts, in any sprite, can react to.

name: Coordinates
explanation: Coordinates say where a sprite is. x goes from -240 at the left to 240 at the right. y goes from -180 at the bottom to 180 at the top.

name: Direction
explanation: Direction is the way a sprite faces, in degrees: 90 is right, 0 is up, -90 is left and 180 is down.

name: Costume
explanation: A costume is one picture of a sprite. Switching between costumes can make it look as if it moves.

name: Backdrop
explanation: A backdrop is a picture behind all the sprites, on the stage.

name: Clone
explanation: A clone is a copy of a sprite made while the project runs. It can have its own position and behaviour.

name: Value
explanation: A value is a number, text or true or false. Blocks that give a value fit into the slots of other blocks.

name: Operator
explanation: An operator works something out, such as adding numbers, comparing values or joining text.

name: Debugging
explanation: Debugging is finding out why a program does not do what you expect: run it, notice what happens, check one block at a time and change one thing.

name: Drawing or walking a square
explanation: To go round a square, repeat four times: move forward, then turn 90 degrees. A short wait between moves lets you notice each one.
